name: swapy-without-components
title: Swapy Raw Grid
blurb: Example drag-and-drop grid using raw Swapy with colored item tiles.
description: A premade layout demonstrating direct Swapy usage with a grid of colored boxes, optional drag handles per item, and event callbacks for swap lifecycle.
use_when: Learning how Swapy works, or starting a drag-and-drop layout from this template.
avoid_when: Production use — this is a template; use the component-based Swapy wrapper for reusability.
a11y: Grid layout with data attributes for Swapy; no semantic markup or keyboard drag support visible.
